single.rationale: HCSG shows improving cash generation (OCF jumped to $145M in 2025) and an attractive 10.5% FCF yield, but faces meaningful headwinds including flat revenue growth over multiple years (2.8% 3-year CAGR), thin margins (3.2% net margin), customer concentration risk in a reimbursement-dependent industry, and a material $63.9M bad debt charge from Genesis bankruptcy that underscores customer credit concerns. The business model's short-term contracts (30-90 day cancellation) and exposure to labor cost inflation with uncertain pass-through ability create execution risk.
